title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF Libya delivered downstream WASH services for flood-affected communities, Sudanese refugees, migrants and host populations. UNICEF enabled 642,600 people to access basic drinking water, provided humanitarian drinking water to 128,100 people, and delivered humanitarian sanitation services to 127,000 people. Hygiene support reached 129,500 people, reducing public health risks.
